visualCharacteristics.purpose: dismissible site-wide notice bar with an icon, a short message with inline links and a close button (dismissal remembered for the session)

contentPattern.structure: one row; cells: [icon (optional, image or :icon:)] [message text with links]

reuseGuidance: Use for a short, dismissible site-wide notice. Not for in-page content callouts (use callout-banner).
